items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: "We had a lot of other things he had written, just a marvelous musician... 'Boy Meets Horn' with Duke Ellington. Rex."

ctx.x: Rex Stewart, oh God bless him. What a wonderful musician he was. You know, that composition on “Boy Meets Horn.” We had a lot of other things he had written, just a marvelous musician, and of course one of a kind I think.
So how did — did you eventually decide, let’s see, late 40s, early 50s, that the road thing was getting a little old?
